observations.source_product_ref: NASA Science resource; 1,118 Mastcam-Z image frames assembled into a color-enhanced panorama. Individual PDS product IDs are not listed on the resource page.
observations.description: NASA reports that the panorama depicts the Jezero delta, including Hogwallow Flats and Skinner Ridge, and describes layered sedimentary rocks. The panorama is a published aggregate, not a substitute for the individual PDS image products.
observations.data_quality: NASA-published, color-enhanced aggregate; individual frame product IDs and per-frame metadata are not represented here.
limitations: The NASA resource identifies the image count and acquisition sols but does not expose individual PDS product IDs or rover coordinates.
The panorama is color-enhanced; color should not be treated as raw calibrated spectral data.

observations.source_product_ref: data/science/meda/raw/WE__0001___________DER_PS__________________P02.CSV and its detached PDS4 XML label
observations.description: Perseverance MEDA pressure time series for sol 1. Row-level times are provided as SCLK, LMST and LTST; UTC bounds are product-level metadata from the detached label.
observations.data_quality: PDS4 label MD5 verified against the unchanged source CSV. The table has no quality-flag column; empty pressure values are retained as missing in raw and excluded from the processed output.
observations.confidence_rationale: PDS product identity and checksum are verified; the pressure uncertainty values are absent from this sampled product.
limitations: The product does not provide rover latitude/longitude or per-row UTC timestamps.
PRESSURE_UNCERTAINTY values are blank in this product; the detached label also declares an anomalous kelvin unit for that pressure-uncertainty field, so the uncertainty column is not used.
This is a historical rover-local measurement and is not a current weather report or astronaut forecast.
